btnCancel: Closes the window; nothing is saved.
btnOK: Makes the folders on the BMS PC and opens the save window there. The name and number become the card's mission and package too.
txtPackageNr: The package number: the folder inside the mission's. It cannot be empty; it starts as the card's package.
txtMissionName: The mission name: the folder under DataCards on the BMS PC the file goes in (DataCards\<mission>\<package>\<callsign>). It cannot be empty.
